content: Hun khakbel sungah mi pawlkhat te upna pan in tai tu uh a, paikhialna thaa le doai te kihilna te zui zawk tu thupisak tu uh hi, ci in Thaa in thiangtak in son hi.
Kihisakna taw leilot thu te son uh a, amate khentel theina te sia thiksa taw kaangsak in a hikcip bang a hihi;
Kitenna te khaam uh a, a umte le thuman a he te in lungdamko in a san tu uh Pathian i piansak an te zong pial tu in thupia uh hi.
Banghangziam cile Pathian i piansak theampo sia a pha hi a, lungdamko in i sang ahile nial tu khat zong om ngawl hi:
Banghangziam cile Pathian kammal le thungetna tungtawn in thiangthosak zo hi.
Upna kammal le hilna pha taw a kivak le na zuisa thu te sia suapui te na phawksak kik le, nangma sia Jesus Christ i naseam pha na hi tu hi.
Ahihang Pathian thusimngawl le nupi huai te phuatawm tangthu te nial in a, taciang Pathianmi hina lam ah nangma le nangma ki hil in.
Banghangziam cile damna tu in cilesa lam hilna sia tawm bekma phatuam hi: ahihang Pathianmi hina in tu hun le hongpai pheang tu hun atu in kamciam nei a, na theampo sungah phatuam hi.
Hi thu sia a thuman kammal hi a, a vekpi in san thamman hi.
Tua ahikom kote na seam in zawnsakna zong ka thuak uh hi, banghangziam cile a nungta Pathian ka muang uh hi, Ama sia mi theampo a ngum pa hi a, a tuan in a umte a ngum pa a hihi.
Hi thupiak te pia in a, hil in.
Khangno na hi hu in kuama in hong zawngsak heak hen; ahihang na kammal, na nuntakzia, itna, na thaa, upna le thianthona lam ah thu umte ette tak in om in.
Na kung kongpai dong, laithiangtho simna, hanthotna le hilna sungah hanciam in hun zang in.
Na sungah a om letsong sia ngaingon heak in, tua letsong sia elder te i khutsuan in le maisang thu pualakna tungtawn in na tungah hong kipia a hihi.
Na khantona sia mi theampo tungah a kilang thei natu in, hi thu te ngaisun tawntung in; nangma le nangma amate tungah ki pumpiak in.
Nangma hina le na hilna kidawm in; tua sungah tatsat ngawl in om in: banghangziam cile tabang na vawt hu in nangma le na thuhilna a zate na tankhia zo tu hi.
